measurement_boundary: Machine idle with the notebook kernel open and no computation, for baseline_seconds. Measures the fixed background draw included in every machine-mode run, to separate fixed from data-dependent energy when scaling. CodeCarbon machine mode measures the whole computer, so the idle desktop, display output and any other open programs (e.g. TensorBoard, browser) are included; see the idle-baseline run for this fixed background draw.
notes: Close other heavy programs, including TensorBoard, and leave the computer untouched during this run.
